note: Caps checked by `npm run perf:check` (scripts/perf.mjs --budget). Only the numbers that do not depend on the machine are caps: draw calls, triangles, textures, geometries, heap, download (firstDownloadMB: the MB asked for before the first frame, #190, 2026-11-09). They sit about 10% over the 2026-11-06 baseline (the downloads: 10% over the #190 run, 2026-11-07), so a PR that adds cost fails and must raise the cap on purpose, with a line in docs/decisions.md. Frame times are not capped here: headless Chromium uses SwiftShader (a software GPU), so they are relative only. See docs/perf/baseline.md for the targets on real devices. phone/pbr is pbr lite (#246, 2026-11-10, docs/perf/246/README.md): its caps sit about 10% over the 2026-11-10 run, and its vsToon block caps each metric as a ratio to the phone/toon run of the same pass (textureMB is the estimate of src/perf/texture-memory.js), so run both looks.
